  shows "tol < (b - a) / (2::real)^k \<longleftrightarrow>

    by (intro divide_pos_pos; linarith)

    using postive_tolerance
    by (simp add: less_divide_eq mult.commute)

    using ratio_pos
    by (simp add: log_less_cancel_iff)
  also have "... \<longleftrightarrow>
             int k < \<lceil>log 2 ((b - a) / tol)\<rceil>"
    by (simp add: bisec_log_power less_ceiling_iff)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma bisec_bracket_root:
  fixes p q :: real
  assumes "a \<le> p" "p < q" "q \<le> b" "f p * f q \<le> 0"
  shows "\<exists>c::real. f c = 0 \<and> c \<in> {a<..<b} \<and>
                         p \<le> c \<and> c \<le> q"
proof -
  have subset: "{p..q} \<subseteq> {a..b}"
    using assms(1,3) by auto
  have cont: "continuous_on {p..q} f"
    using continuous_f subset by (meson continuous_on_subset)
  have root: "\<exists>c \<in> {p..q}. f c = 0"
  proof (cases "f p = 0 \<or> f q = 0")
    case True
    then show ?thesis
      using assms(2)
      by (meson atLeastAtMost_iff less_imp_le order_refl)
  next
    case False
    have strict: "f p * f q < 0"
      using assms(4) False by (auto simp: less_le)
    show ?thesis
      using cont strict assms(2,4)
      by (metis Bolzanos_theorem atLeastAtMost_iff
                greaterThanLessThan_iff less_imp_le)
  qed
  obtain c where fc: "f c = 0" and pc: "p \<le> c" and cq: "c \<le> q"
    using root by auto
  have nonzero_a: "f a \<noteq> 0" and nonzero_b: "f b \<noteq> 0"
    using opposite_signs by auto
  have ne_a: "c \<noteq> a" and ne_b: "c \<noteq> b"
    using fc nonzero_a nonzero_b by auto
  have ac: "a \<le> c"
    using assms(1) pc by linarith
  have cb: "c \<le> b"
    using assms(3) cq by linarith
  have interior: "a < c \<and> c < b"
    using ac cb ne_a ne_b by (auto simp: less_le)
  show ?thesis
    by (intro exI[where x = c]) (use fc pc cq interior in auto)
qed

lemma bisec_distance_bound:
  fixes p q m c :: real
  assumes "p \<le> c" "c \<le> q" "p \<le> m" "m \<le> q"
  shows "\<bar>c - m\<bar> \<le> q - p"
  using assms
  by (simp only: abs_le_iff; intro conjI; linarith)

lemma bisec_finish:
  fixes p q m :: real and k :: nat
  assumes "a \<le> p" "p < q" "q \<le> b" "f p * f q \<le> 0"
    and "p \<le> m" "m \<le> q"
    and "q - p = (b - a) / (2::real)^k"
    and "q - p \<le> tol"
    and "int k \<le> \<lceil>log 2 ((b - a) / tol)\<rceil>"
  shows "\<exists>c::real. f c = 0 \<and> c \<in> {a<..<b} \<and>
          q - p \<le> tol \<and>
          \<bar>c - m\<bar> \<le> (b - a) / (2::real)^k \<and>
          \<bar>c - m\<bar> \<le> tol \<and>
          int k = \<lceil>log 2 ((b - a) / tol)\<rceil>"
proof -
  obtain c where fc: "f c = 0" and interior: "c \<in> {a<..<b}"
    and pc: "p \<le> c" and cq: "c \<le> q"
    using bisec_bracket_root[OF assms(1-4)] by blast
  have distance: "\<bar>c - m\<bar> \<le> q - p"
    using pc cq assms(5,6) by (rule bisec_distance_bound)
  have width_bound: "\<bar>c - m\<bar> \<le> (b - a) / (2::real)^k"
    using distance assms(7) by simp
  have tolerance_bound: "\<bar>c - m\<bar> \<le> tol"
    using distance assms(8) by linarith
  have width_tol: "(b - a) / (2::real)^k \<le> tol"
    using assms(7,8) by linarith
  have count: "int k = \<lceil>log 2 ((b - a) / tol)\<rceil>"
    using bisec_count_exit[OF assms(9) width_tol] .
  show ?thesis
    using fc interior assms(8) width_bound tolerance_bound count
    by blast
qed
